decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core modular sensing platform and its move from a mere mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests growing relevance and likely customer uptake.

This industrial AC voltage input module is closely aligned with the firm's automation offering, stayed prominently marketed across both years, and supports the strategic shift toward newer industrial connector-based products.
A solid state relay module is a natural complement to the firm's control and automation ecosystem, and even with modest web prominence it strengthens the completeness of the modular product range.
Although newly launched, the RGB LED control module extends the existing building-block system at low strategic risk and suits the firm's developer, education and automation customer base.
The remote access service directly supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy-management products and offers a scalable software layer around its wallbox business.
